outcome: frequency and diagnostic accuracy of clinical signs (right lower quadrant tenderness, guarding, rebound tenderness, symptom duration)
rate of open appendectomies or conversion
cohort: 99 pregnant women and 1796 non-pregnant women aged 16 to 49 who underwent emergency appendectomy for suspected appendicitis between January 2008 and June 2023.
finding: Pregnant women undergoing appendectomy for suspected appendicitis exhibited an atypical clinical presentation, reduced ultrasound diagnostic accuracy, longer operating times, higher rates of open surgery, longer hospital stays, and a higher perforation rate compared to non-pregnant women.
